abstract: In childhood mature cystic teratomas are the most common type of ovarian germ cell tumors. Tumors of neuroepithelial origin are extremely rare in mature teratomas. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first case report oligodendroglioma arising in a mature cystic ovarian teratoma in children. A 13-year-old girl presented with a history of pelvic pain for 2 months. An ultrasound examination showed a monolateral multicystic, calcific ovarian mass, measuring approximately 6 x 5 cm, arising in the left over and adnexia, suggesting a teratoma. An exploratorative laparotomy and ooferectomy were performed. On histopatological examination, various samples from cystic areas had mature tissues from all 3 germ cell layers, including skin, bone, bronchial structures, and cerebellum. Sections from solid areas showed uniform population of monotonous, rounded cells with indistinct cytoplasm and having perinuclear halo (fried-egg appearance) on a fibrillary, neuropilic background. Microcalcifications as calcospherites were noted in the stroma. Based on the typical morphological features, the cased was diagnosed as mature cystic teratoma with low-grade oligodendroglioma. To the authors' knowledge, there are a few reports in the literature of an oligodendroglioma arising in an ovarian teratoma in adults and this presented patient is the first case in childhood.
abstract_ja: 小児において成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の中で最も多いタイプである。成熟奇形腫に神経上皮由来の腫瘍が生じることは極めてまれである。著者らの知る限り、小児の成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫に乏突起膠腫が生じた初めての症例報告である。13歳女児が2か月にわたる骨盤痛を主訴に来院した。超音波検査で、左卵巣および付属器から発生した、約6×5cmの単側性多嚢胞性・石灰化を伴う卵巣腫瘤が認められ、奇形腫が疑われた。開腹探索術および卵巣摘出術が施行された。組織学的検査では、嚢胞部の標本に皮膚、骨、気管支構造、小脳を含む3胚葉すべての成熟組織が認められた。充実部の標本では、均一で単調な円形細胞の集団が、核周囲の透明帯(目玉焼き様の外観)を伴って、線維状で神経毛状の背景に認められた。間質には石灰化小体としての微小石灰化が認められた。典型的な形態学的特徴に基づき、本症例は低悪性度の乏突起膠腫を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。成人の卵巣奇形腫から生じた乏突起膠腫の報告はいくつか文献上にあるが、本症例は小児における初めての例である。
